items.title: ACII 2026

items.summary: ACII is one of the central international venues for affective computing. The 2026 conference is useful for tracking emotion recognition, affective interaction, multimodal signals, and responsible deployment.

items.summary_zh: IUI 关注智能界面、自适应交互、用户建模、可解释系统和以人为中心评测，适合情感对话、交互式心理支持和具身智能体等方向。
